title.narrative: Shaanxi Mountain Road Safety Demonstration Project

description.narrative: The project will improve accessibility and road safety by (i) upgrading and introducing safety treatments on trunk and rural roads in the hazardous Qinba Mountains area in southeast Shaanxi, (ii) implementing a crash reduction program involving only road safety treatments on other hazardous rural roads, and (iii) strengthening road safety design and management practices and introducing road safety education and community awareness programs.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3294: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 16 Jan 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: The project achieved the envisaged outcome and outputs, contributing significantly to promote a safer and more efficient trunk and rural road network in southeast Shaanxi Province.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46042/46042-002-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Jul 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46042/46042-002-eia-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jun 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46042/46042-002-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Oct 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46042/46042-002-smr-en_17.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: (1) Three trunk roads have been upgraded with total length of 187.04 km including road G316 (34.39km, class II road), road S102 (60.25km, class II road), and road S224 (92.41km, class II road). Output achieved the targets at appraisal.(2) Eight rural roads with total length of 139.66 km have been upgraded from earthen roads to paved class IV roads, including improved safety design enhancements. Output achieved the targets at appraisal.(3) Implemented crash reduction program on 23 additional roads with total length of 466.38 km. Output achieved the targets at appraisal.(4) Activities were successfully conducted under this output.
